additional_info.subject: Case Note
additional_info.body:
Dear Support,
My colleague using the Sicharge D charging station reports me the following behavior :
Authentication / Charging process can start successfully.
But after a sometime, the charging stops, even if the battery of the truck isn't fully charged (limit set to 100%)
He can start the process again, and the truck continues charging till 100% (or if it stop manually).
Happens a few times, mainly on the end of day (17 / 17h30).
Could you please kindly have a look on the device log to see what can cause the issue ?
Human intervention on the charging station ?
Truck side issue ?
Charging station side ?
Power supply of the charging station ?
Thank you for your analysis and help.
Best Regards,
Valentin

additional_info.subject: ID0482429-DC/Si-D/CH- [NULL] Charging Issue CRM:03431000154
additional_info.body:
Dear Morgane,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided and a deeper system check, we can confirm that the charging station is now operating properly, as shown in the picture:
Regarding the charging sessions you mentioned, they were ended by the EV. Additionally, during the charging process, the EV consistently sent requests to limit the kW. Please note that issues of this nature are typically related to the vehicles themselves and their onboard safety systems.
We encountered a minor issue related to one of the auxiliary systems, which warmed up and was not fully operational for a few moments. This problem was subsequently resolved autonomously by the charger.
We will continue to monitor the charger's performance over the coming days. Should this issue reoccur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed with closing the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0482429-DC/Si-D/CH- [RVP / T6 170004833] Charging Issue CRM:03277000252
additional_info.body:
Dear
Morgane Rocchi
I would like to inform you that your support case
0482429
has been resolved.
Here is a summary of the actions taken:
Following a review of the information provided and a deeper system check, we can confirm that the charging sessions mentioned were terminated by the EV. Additionally, during the charging process, the EV consistently sent requests to limit the power output (kW). Please note that issues of this nature are typically related to the vehicles themselves and their onboard safety systems.
We encountered a minor issue related to one of the auxiliary systems, which overheated and was not fully operational for a few moments. This problem was subsequently resolved automatically by the charger.
We have monitored charger
RVP / T6 170004833j
for a few days and didn’t observe any recurrence of this minor issue.
Since the reported issue has been resolved, I will proceed to close this case.
Thank you for your cooperation, and please don’t hesitate to reach out through our support form for any future requests:
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Ivan Perotto
